result.stdout:
Description:
  Opener Tool - quickly open links, paths, stored data, and REST shortcuts.
  
  Examples:
    o list
    o add jira "https://jira.company.com/browse/{0}" -t WebPath
    o jira PROJ-123
    o add api "https://nexus<env>.bpc.com/<region>/<user>" -t WebPath --url-aliases '{ "env": { "d": "-dev", "p": "" } }' --default-params '{ "user": "kchirravuri" }'
    o api env=d region=us

Usage:
  Opener [command] [options]

Options:
  --version       Show version information
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information

Commands:
  config                Manage storage, encryption, and global URL template settings.
  
                        Examples:
                          o config show
                          o config set-encryption portable --password my-secret
                          o config set-url-aliases env d=-dev u=-uat p=
                          o config set-url-aliases --file aliases.json
                          o config set-default-params user kchirravuri
  export <file>         Export all keys to a portable encrypted backup file.
  
                        Example:
                          o export backup.dat --password my-export-password
  import <file>         Import keys from a portable encrypted backup file. Existing keys with the same name are updated.
  
                        Example:
                          o import backup.dat --password my-export-password
  add <key> <value>     Add a new key.
  
                        Examples:
                          o add token "secret-value" -t Data
                          o add jira "https://jira.company.com/browse/{0}" -t WebPath
                          o add api "https://nexus<env>.bpc.com/<region>/<user>" -t WebPath
                          o config set-url-aliases env d=-dev u=-uat p=
                          o config set-default-params user kchirravuri
  update <key> <value>  Update an existing key's value and optionally replace its per-key URL aliases/default params.
  
                        Examples:
                          o update jira "https://jira.company.com/browse/{0}"
                          o update api "https://nexus<env>.bpc.com/<region>/<user>"
                          o config set-url-aliases env d=-dev u=-uat p=
  delete <key>          Delete a stored key.
  
                        Example:
                          o delete jira
  list                  List all stored keys with type and a safe value preview.

Description:
  Manage storage, encryption, and global URL template settings.
  
  Examples:
    o config show
    o config set-encryption portable --password my-secret
    o config set-url-aliases env d=-dev u=-uat p=
    o config set-url-aliases --file aliases.json
    o config set-default-params user kchirravuri

Usage:
  Opener config [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information

Commands:
  show                                      Show current storage path, encryption mode, global URL aliases, and global default params.
  set-location <path>                       Set a custom encrypted data-file path.
  
                                            Example:
                                              o config set-location "C:\Users\me\OneDrive\opener.dat"
  set-encryption <mode>                     Switch between local machine encryption and portable password encryption.
  
                                            Examples:
                                              o config set-encryption local
                                              o config set-encryption portable --password my-secret
  clear-password                            Clear the cached portable-mode password from the local credential store.
  set-url-aliases <placeholder> <aliases>   Set a global URL alias map for one placeholder, or replace all global alias maps from a JSON file.
  
                                            Aliases translate compact input values before a URL template is opened. For a template containing <env>, this can turn 'd' into '-dev' or 'p' into an empty production suffix.
  
                                            Examples:
                                              o config set-url-aliases env d=-dev u=-uat p=
                                              o config set-url-aliases region us=na eu=emea
                                              o config set-url-aliases --file aliases.json
  clear-url-aliases                         Clear all global URL alias maps. Per-key aliases are not changed.
  clear-url-alias <placeholder>             Clear one global URL alias map by placeholder name.
  set-default-params <placeholder> <value>  Set one global default value, or replace all global defaults from a JSON file.
  
                                            Defaults are used when a named placeholder is not supplied by positional args or key=value args.
  
                                            Examples:
                                              o config set-default-params user kchirravuri
                                              o config set-default-params region us
                                              o config set-default-params --file defaults.json
  clear-default-params                      Clear all global default placeholder values. Per-key defaults are not changed.
  clear-default-param <placeholder>         Clear one global default value by placeholder name.
